opening.argument: The presentation actively promotes BitConnect lending as a way to earn returns through a trading bot, including claims of up to 2% daily for approximately 299 days and repayment of the invested money. It further presents an example of $10,000 becoming $25,000 after four months, while directing viewers to participate through the speaker's link: "you can sign up with my link down below in the description." Viewers are told that funds are converted into BCC tokens and placed into lending, with the dashboard showing a lending action and investment activity. Although the calculator page includes investment-risk language, the promised returns and repayment are not verified, and the overall presentation still encourages viewers to enter the scheme.
